1.english_reference: On that night could not the king sleep

traditions.WLC: בַּ לַּ֣יְלָה הַ ה֔וּא נָדְדָ֖ה שְׁנַ֣ת הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: Ὁ δὲ κύριος ἀπέστησεν τὸν ὕπνον ἀπὸ τοῦ βασιλέως τὴν νύκτα ἐκείνην ,
traditions.VUL: Noctem illam duxit rex insómnem ,
traditions.KJV: On that night could not the king sleep ,

1.english_reference: and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֗אמֶר לְ הָבִ֞יא אֶת סֵ֤פֶר הַ זִּכְרֹנוֹת֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ יָּמִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν τῷ διδασκάλῳ αὐτοῦ εἰσφέρειν γράμματα μνημόσυνα τῶν ἡμερῶν
traditions.VUL: iussítque sibi afférri histórias et annáles priórum témporum .
traditions.KJV: and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles ;

1.english_reference: and they were read before the king

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּהְי֥וּ נִקְרָאִ֖ים לִ פְנֵ֥י הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: ἀναγινώσκειν αὐτῷ .
traditions.VUL: Quæ cum illo præsénte legeréntur ,
traditions.KJV: and they were read before the king .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמָּצֵ֣א כָת֗וּב
traditions.LXX: εὗρεν δὲ τὰ γράμματα τὰ γραφέντα
traditions.VUL: ventum est ad illum locum ubi scriptum erat ,
traditions.KJV: And it was found written ,

2.english_reference: that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s chamberlains, the keepers of the door

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר֩ הִגִּ֨יד מָרְדֳּכַ֜י עַל בִּגְתָ֣נָא וָ תֶ֗רֶשׁ שְׁנֵי֙ סָרִיסֵ֣י הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ מִ שֹּׁמְרֵ֖י הַ סַּ֑ף
traditions.LXX: περὶ Μαρδοχαίου , ὡς ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ βασιλεῖ περὶ τῶν δύο εὐνούχων τοῦ βασιλέως ἐν τῷ φυλάσσειν αὐτοὺς
traditions.VUL: quómodo nuntiásset Mardochǽus insídias Bagáthan et Thares eunuchórum ,
traditions.KJV: that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh , two of the king ’s chamberlains , the keepers of the door ,

2.english_reference: who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֤ר בִּקְשׁוּ֙ לִ שְׁלֹ֣חַ יָ֔ד בַּ מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ζητῆσαι ἐπιβαλεῖν τὰς χεῖρας Ἀρταξέρξῃ .
traditions.VUL: regem Assuérum iuguláre cupiéntium .
traditions.KJV: who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .

3.english_reference: And the king said, What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ מַֽה נַּעֲשָׂ֞ה יְקָ֧ר וּ גְדוּלָּ֛ה לְ מָרְדֳּכַ֖י עַל זֶ֑ה
traditions.LXX: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ βασιλεύς Τίνα δόξαν ἢ χάριν ἐποιήσαμεν τῷ Μαρδοχαίῳ ;
traditions.VUL: Quod cum audísset rex , ait : Quid pro hac fide honóris ac prǽmii Mardochǽus consecútus est ?
traditions.KJV: And the king said , What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this ?

3.english_reference: Then said the king’s servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ נַעֲרֵ֤י הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ מְשָׁ֣רְתָ֔י ו לֹא נַעֲשָׂ֥ה עִמּ֖ וֹ דָּבָֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ διάκονοι τοῦ βασιλέως Οὐκ ἐποίησας αὐτῷ οὐδέν .
traditions.VUL: Dixérunt ei servi illíus ac minístri : Nihil omníno mercédis accépit .
traditions.KJV: Then said the king ’s servants that ministered unto him , There is nothing done for him .

4.english_reference: And the king said , Who [ is ] in the court ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֥אמֶר הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ מִ֣י בֶ חָצֵ֑ר
traditions.LXX: ἐν δὲ τῷ πυνθάνεσθαι τὸν βασιλέα περὶ τῆς εὐνοίας Μαρδοχαίου , ἰδοὺ Ἁμὰν ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ · εἶπεν δὲ ὁ βασιλεύς Τίς ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ ;
traditions.VUL: Statímque rex : Quis est , inquit , in átrio ?
traditions.KJV: And the king said , Who [ is ] in the court ?

4.english_reference: Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king ’s house ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הָמָ֣ן בָּ֗א לַ חֲצַ֤ר בֵּית הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ חִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ Ἁμὰν εἰσῆλθεν
traditions.VUL: Aman quippe intérius átrium domus regíæ intráverat ,
traditions.KJV: Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king ’s house ,

4.english_reference: to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him .

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֣ר לַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ לִ תְלוֹת֙ אֶֽת מָרְדֳּכַ֔י עַל הָ עֵ֖ץ אֲשֶׁר הֵכִ֥ין לֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: εἰπεῖν τῷ βασιλεῖ κρεμάσαι τὸν Μαρδοχαῖον ἐπὶ τῷ ξύλῳ ᾧ ἡτοίμασεν .
traditions.VUL: ut suggéreret regi , et iubéret Mardochǽum affígi patíbulo , quod ei fúerat præparátum .
traditions.KJV: to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him .

5.english_reference: And the king’s servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ נַעֲרֵ֤י הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֵלָ֔י ו הִנֵּ֥ה הָמָ֖ן עֹמֵ֣ד בֶּ חָצֵ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ διάκονοι τοῦ βασιλέως Ἰδοὺ Ἁμὰν ἕστηκεν ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ ·
traditions.VUL: Respondérunt púeri : Aman stat in átrio .
traditions.KJV: And the king ’s servants said unto him , Behold , Haman standeth in the court .

5.english_reference: And the king said, Let him come in

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֥אמֶר הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ יָבֽוֹא
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς Καλέσατε αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: Dixítque rex : Ingrediátur .
traditions.KJV: And the king said , Let him come in .

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבוֹא֮ הָמָן֒
traditions.VUL: Cumque esset ingréssus ,
traditions.KJV: So Haman came in .

6.english_reference: And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר ל וֹ֙ הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ מַה לַ עֲשׂ֕וֹת בָּ אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ חָפֵ֣ץ בִּ יקָר֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ Ἁμάν Τί ποιήσω τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ὃν ἐγὼ θέλω δοξάσαι ;
traditions.VUL: ait illi : Quid debet fíeri viro , quem rex honoráre desíderat ?
traditions.KJV: And the king said unto him , What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour ?

6.english_reference: Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר הָמָן֙ בְּ לִבּ֔ וֹ לְ מִ֞י יַחְפֹּ֥ץ הַ מֶּ֛לֶךְ לַ עֲשׂ֥וֹת יְקָ֖ר יוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּֽ נִּי
traditions.LXX: εἶπεν δὲ ἐν ἑαυτῷ ὁ Ἁμάν Τίνα θέλει ὁ βασιλεὺς δοξάσαι εἰ μὴ ἐμέ ;
traditions.VUL: Cógitans autem in corde suo Aman , et réputans quod nullum álium rex , nisi se , vellet honoráre ,
traditions.KJV: Now Haman thought in his heart , To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself ?

7.english_reference: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֥אמֶר הָמָ֖ן אֶל הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ יקָרֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Ἄνθρωπον ὃν ὁ βασιλεὺς θέλει δοξάσαι ,
traditions.VUL: respóndit : Homo , quem rex honoráre cupit ,
traditions.KJV: And Haman answered the king , For the man whom the king delighteth to honour ,

8.english_reference: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king [ useth ] to wear ,

traditions.WLC: יָבִ֨יאוּ֙ לְב֣וּשׁ מַלְכ֔וּת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָֽבַשׁ בּ֖ וֹ הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐνεγκάτωσαν οἱ παῖδες τοῦ βασιλέως στολὴν βυσσίνην ἣν ὁ βασιλεὺς περιβάλλεται ,
traditions.VUL: debet índui véstibus régiis ,
traditions.KJV: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king [ useth ] to wear ,

8.english_reference: and the horse that the king rideth upon ,

traditions.WLC: וְ ס֗וּס אֲשֶׁ֨ר רָכַ֤ב עָלָי ו֙ הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἵππον ἐφ᾽ ὃν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐπιβαίνει ,
traditions.VUL: et impóni super equum , qui de sella regis est ,
traditions.KJV: and the horse that the king rideth upon ,

8.english_reference: and the crown royal which is set upon his head :

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִתַּ֛ן כֶּ֥תֶר מַלְכ֖וּת בְּ רֹאשֽׁ וֹ
traditions.VUL: et accípere régium diadéma super caput suum ,
traditions.KJV: and the crown royal which is set upon his head :

9.english_reference: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes

traditions.WLC: וְ נָת֨וֹן הַ לְּב֜וּשׁ וְ הַ סּ֗וּס עַל יַד אִ֞ישׁ מִ שָּׂרֵ֤י הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַֽ פַּרְתְּמִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ δότω ἑνὶ τῶν φίλων τοῦ βασιλέως τῶν ἐνδόξων
traditions.VUL: et primus de régiis princípibus ac tyránnis téneat equum eius ,
traditions.KJV: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king ’s most noble princes ,

9.english_reference: that they may array the man [ withal ] whom the king delighteth to honour

traditions.WLC: וְ הִלְבִּ֨ישׁוּ֙ אֶת הָ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ חָפֵ֣ץ בִּֽ יקָר֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ στολισάτω τὸν ἄνθρωπον ὃν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἀγαπᾷ ,
traditions.KJV: that they may array the man [ withal ] whom the king delighteth to honour ,

9.english_reference: and bring him on horseback through the street of the city

traditions.WLC: וְ הִרְכִּיבֻ֤ הוּ עַל הַ סּוּס֙ בִּ רְח֣וֹב הָ עִ֔יר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀναβιβασάτω αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸν ἵππον , καὶ κηρυσσέτω διὰ τῆς πλατείας τῆς πόλεως
traditions.VUL: et per platéam civitátis incédens clamet ,
traditions.KJV: and bring him on horseback through the street of the city ,

9.english_reference: and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour

traditions.WLC: וְ קָרְא֣וּ לְ פָנָ֔י ו כָּ֚כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה לָ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ יקָרֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: λέγων Οὕτως ἔσται παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ ὃν ὁ βασιλεὺς δοξάζει .
traditions.VUL: et dicat : Sic honorábitur , quemcúmque volúerit rex honoráre .
traditions.KJV: and proclaim before him , Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour .

10.english_reference: Then the king said to Haman, Make haste, [ and ] take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ מֶּ֜לֶךְ לְ הָמָ֗ן מַ֠הֵר קַ֣ח אֶת הַ לְּב֤וּשׁ וְ אֶת הַ סּוּס֙ כַּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֔רְתָּ
traditions.LXX: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ Ἁμάν Καλῶς ἐλάλησας ·
traditions.VUL: Dixítque ei rex : Festína , et sumpta stola et equo , fac , ut locútus es ,
traditions.KJV: Then the king said to Haman , Make haste , [ and ] take the apparel and the horse , as thou hast said ,

10.english_reference: and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king’s gate

traditions.WLC: וַֽ עֲשֵׂה כֵן֙ לְ מָרְדֳּכַ֣י הַ יְּהוּדִ֔י הַ יּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ שַׁ֣עַר הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: οὕτως ποίησον τῷ Μαρδοχαίῳ τῷ Ἰουδαίῳ τῷ θεραπεύοντι ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ ,
traditions.VUL: Mardochǽo Iudǽo , qui sedet ante fores palátii .
traditions.KJV: and do even so to Mordecai the Jew , that sitteth at the king ’s gate :

10.english_reference: let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken

traditions.WLC: אַל תַּפֵּ֣ל דָּבָ֔ר מִ כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ μὴ παραπεσάτω σου λόγος ὧν ἐλάλησας .
traditions.VUL: Cave ne quidquam de his , quæ locútus es , prætermíttas .
traditions.KJV: let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken .

11.english_reference: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּ֤ח הָמָן֙ אֶת הַ לְּב֣וּשׁ וְ אֶת הַ סּ֔וּס
traditions.LXX: ἔλαβεν δὲ Ἁμὰν τὴν στολὴν καὶ τὸν ἵππον ,
traditions.VUL: Tulit ítaque Aman stolam et equum ,
traditions.KJV: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּלְבֵּ֖שׁ אֶֽת מָרְדֳּכָ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐστόλισεν τὸν Μαρδοχαῖον
traditions.VUL: indutúmque Mardochǽum
traditions.KJV: and arrayed Mordecai ,

11.english_reference: and brought him on horseback through the street of the city

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּרְכִּיבֵ֨ הוּ֙ בִּ רְח֣וֹב הָ עִ֔יר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνεβίβασεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸν ἵππον , καὶ διῆλθεν διὰ τῆς πλατείας τῆς πόλεως
traditions.VUL: in platéa civitátis , et impósitum equo præcedébat ,
traditions.KJV: and brought him on horseback through the street of the city ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָ֣א לְ פָנָ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκήρυσσεν λέγων
traditions.VUL: atque clamábat :
traditions.KJV: and proclaimed before him ,

11.english_reference: Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour

traditions.WLC: ו כָּ֚כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה לָ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ יקָרֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως ἔσται παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ ὃν ὁ βασιλεὺς θέλει δοξάσαι .
traditions.VUL: Hoc honóre condígnus est , quemcúmque rex volúerit honoráre .
traditions.KJV: Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour .

12.english_reference: And Mordecai came again to the king ’s gate

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֥שָׁב מָרְדֳּכַ֖י אֶל שַׁ֣עַר הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐπέστρεψεν δὲ ὁ Μαρδοχαῖος εἰς τὴν αὐλήν ·
traditions.VUL: Reversúsque est Mardochǽus ad iánuam palátii :
traditions.KJV: And Mordecai came again to the king ’s gate .

12.english_reference: But Haman hasted to his house mourning , and having his head covered

traditions.WLC: וְ הָמָן֙ נִדְחַ֣ף אֶל בֵּית֔ וֹ אָבֵ֖ל וַ חֲפ֥וּי רֹֽאשׁ
traditions.LXX: Ἁμὰν δὲ ὑπέστρεψεν εἰς τὰ ἴδια λυπούμενος κατὰ κεφαλῆς .
traditions.VUL: et Aman festinávit ire in domum suam , lugens et opérto cápite :
traditions.KJV: But Haman hasted to his house mourning , and having his head covered .

14.english_reference: And while they [ were ] yet talking with him

traditions.WLC: עוֹדָ ם֙ מְדַבְּרִ֣ים עִמּ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ἔτι αὐτῶν λαλούντων
traditions.VUL: Adhuc illis loquéntibus ,
traditions.KJV: And while they [ were ] yet talking with him ,

traditions.WLC: וְ סָרִיסֵ֥י הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ הִגִּ֑יעוּ
traditions.LXX: παραγίνονται οἱ εὐνοῦχοι
traditions.VUL: venérunt eunúchi regis ,
traditions.KJV: came the king ’s chamberlains ,

14.english_reference: and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּבְהִ֨לוּ֙ לְ הָבִ֣יא אֶת הָמָ֔ן אֶל הַ מִּשְׁתֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר עָשְׂתָ֥ה אֶסְתֵּֽר
traditions.LXX: ἐπισπεύδοντες τὸν Ἁμὰν ἐπὶ τὸν πότον ὃν ἡτοίμασεν Ἐσθήρ .
traditions.VUL: et cito eum ad convívium , quod regína paráverat , pérgere compulérunt .
traditions.KJV: and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared .
